title: aye qateele jafa alvida alvida
body:
aye qateele jafa alvida alvida
shaahe gardu nishaa'n alvida alvida
noore chashme nabi jaanasheene nabi
aye imaame shisham, haaye kaisa sitam
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde dil kar diya alvida alvida
bacche rote hai sab bewa to taab hai
dekho uth kar zara alvida alvida
aye shahe zee maqaam, haaye jafar imaam
<<DIVIDER>>
tum pe shia fida alvida alvida
